title: Add configurable internal and external FPS overlay
changes: Add Video > FPS counter with Off, Internal, External and Both modes, persisted as video.fps in av.cfg (commit 401922d).
Show a compact high-contrast HUD with guest frame and host presentation rates, independent of game zoom; reset sampling after pause or mode changes.
validation: 75 Windows tests passed through Wine across runtime, menu, configuration and GPU layer equivalence.
Interactive Wine smoke verified menu selection, persistence, normal INT/EXT rates and different rates under fast forward.
limitations: External FPS counts successful host presentations, not physical display scanouts.
Native Windows interactive behavior remains unverified.
